clips.title: The story
paras: Apothecary Zamah seeks a way to drive the Venture Company from Stonetalon Mountains without open war. She sends you across the sea to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, where the Royal Apothecary Society works in Lordaeron.

In Thunder Bluff, Apothecary Zamah is a link between the Forsaken and the Earth Mother's children. The Venture Company is logging and mining the sacred lands of Stonetalon Mountains, and the tauren have found that ordinary methods will not stop them. Zamah turns to her peers in the Royal Apothecary Society for a chemical deterrent. She hopes their alchemy can drive the company out without a drawn-out war.

You cross the sea from Kalimdor by zeppelin toward Lordaeron and the Undercity. From Tirisfal Glades, the road leads south through Silverpine Forest and into the contested Hillsbrad Foothills. Tarren Mill lies near human farmsteads and ruins. Once a human hamlet, it is now a Forsaken stronghold and a place where the Royal Apothecary Society carries out its research.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To rid Stonetalon of the Venture Company, we must take extreme measures. Extreme, but without bloodshed.
A colleague of mine may have just the tool we need. His name is Lydon; he dwells in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, in the distant land of Lordaeron.
To reach Hillsbrad, travel by zeppelin to our capital, the Undercity. Then go north to Tirisfal Glades, southwest to Silverpine, and south to Hillsbrad.
Seek Lydon and bring him this note. It details our needs to him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A note from Zamah? Her needs must be great to send word from so far. Let us see what she says...
Ah, splendid! I know exactly what to do!
